findings.title: Auth middleware installed
findings.manual_action:
Integrate require_agent_auth() into each agent:
  • publishing_controller (: 8090) — load AGENT_TOKEN_PUBLISHING_CONTROLLER from .agent_tokens.env and call require_agent_auth('{env}') in a before_request hook.
  • bot_factory (: 8091) — load AGENT_TOKEN_BOT_FACTORY from .agent_tokens.env and call require_agent_auth('{env}') in a before_request hook.
  • universal_submitter (: 8086) — load AGENT_TOKEN_UNIVERSAL_SUBMITTER from .agent_tokens.env and call require_agent_auth('{env}') in a before_request hook.
  • royalty_dashboard (: 8087) — load AGENT_TOKEN_ROYALTY_DASHBOARD from .agent_tokens.env and call require_agent_auth('{env}') in a before_request hook.
All callers must send: Authorization: Bearer <token>
